name: Capture a real file and create a business signal
description: Verifies a supported business document can be dropped, converted, and turned into a real workspace signal.
steps: Drop a supported PDF, TXT, CSV, XLS or XLSX file
Verify the converted filename and text appear
expected: The converted document context is visible and a real conversation signal is created.

name: Enter Early Access through the glass dashboard 7-day trial landing page
description: Verifies the public landing page promotes the 7-day trial with a contained glass dashboard hero and responsive visual framing.
steps: Verify the 7-day trial CTA and glass dashboard hero with soft leaf framing are visible
expected: The trial offer is clearly presented, the hero visual stays contained without floating cards, the phone mockup UI remains contained and readable on mobile, and registration opens the private SignalDesk workspace.

name: Use Business Mentor as a chat assistant
description: Verifies the Business Mentor supports a conversational thread and follow-up questions.
expected: User and assistant messages appear in a clear chat thread and the follow-up is answered.

name: Open the Paddle monthly checkout with SignalDesk metadata
description: Verifies the SignalDesk Pro billing control opens the configured monthly Paddle price and attaches the signed-in SignalDesk user identifier as checkout metadata.
expected: Paddle Checkout opens for the configured monthly price with SignalDesk user metadata attached.

name: Review a public social profile
description: Verifies a user can choose a social platform, submit a public profile URL, and receive a rendered review.
expected: A review result or clear public-page access error is shown without invented page facts, and a Growth plan view exposes grounded next-step suggestions when the AI can establish them.

name: Use a social username on mobile
description: Verifies username mode builds the selected platform profile URL and keeps the form usable on mobile.
expected: SignalDesk builds the public Instagram profile URL and shows analysis or a clear access error.

name: Reject an invalid file safely
description: Verifies unsupported or oversized files do not create a workspace signal.
steps: Choose an unsupported or oversized file
expected: A clear file error appears and no conversation is created.
